choice_scope.basis: Explicit semantic links from selected outputs, contracts, decisions, knowledge and current inputs/nominees, including family destinations. No text/key matching or inferred authority.
choice_scope.limit: Unlinked does not mean irrelevant. Inspect an indexed choice when its applicability is uncertain; preserve global caller instructions. This index changes no saved choice or acceptance rule.

fields.wt: Adopt for the robot.directions family: exact byte reuse of the approved south; reference-conditioned PixelLab V3 object rotation (create_object_pro_flash with the uploaded source as first frame, n_directions 8, view side, source palette) for east and north; and a deterministic horizontal mirror of the accepted east for west, because the provider's west omitted the front edge.
fields.wy: The reviewed representative sample (job r.acf329804ba043b7.request, object 2a3cb51a-6cf7-485d-8441-3c3db762cc9d, 1 generation) passed every saved criterion for east, north and the edited west, and the raw west failed direction/identity; the mirror is geometrically exact for this left-right-symmetric design. Scoped to this family; not a general method claim.

fields.ck: Viewed together at 1x and 3x in one 32x32 cell each, the four facings share the same robot: equal height and ground line, the same navy frame / teal body / pale-yellow eye colours, consistent antenna posts, and a box volume that turns coherently S->E->N->W without a facing looking like a different object or size.
Each file at the controller path spriteFor(facing) shows that facing: assets/robot/south.png front, east.png right, north.png back, west.png left.

renderer-native/check.py reports pass for a capture made from the delivered files with the unchanged controller: all four facings mapped, 32x32 RGBA transparent, south bytes identical to the base, screenshot pixels match the expected nearest-scaled composites.

destination.png and every 1x and 3x cell of that capture, viewed with the host image tool, show the four facings rendered crisply (nearest) over the observation background, transparent around the robot, without resampling blur, cropping or misplacement.
Every pixel outside the robot has alpha 0, the robot has at least one opaque pixel, and there is no opaque matte, backdrop or canvas fill behind it.
The file is a 32x32 RGBA PNG (one frame).
